translations.web: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’
translations.bsb: I will establish his kingdom forever, if he resolutely carries out My commandments and ordinances, as is being done this day.’
translations.kjv: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
translations.asv: And I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and mine ordinances, as at this day.
